checks.behavior: The edit dialog saves a new name and grade of a migrated class. The list shows them. No 400. The new dialog has no "Student password" field (Q1 default, difference on purpose).
Add, edit, and delete each show a success toast. A failed call shows an error toast. A page capture shows the list only; the toasts need the manual steps.
Four tiles. The new fourth tile shows the percent and "n of m students" active in 7 days. Legacy shows 0 percent (E-3), a difference on purpose.
Compare the new tile with the SQL count of migrated-data-checks.sql (FR-3). Make one activity in both apps first.
Settings opens the edit dialog of that class in the new app. Legacy opens the list only (difference on purpose). Capture the page; the Settings click is a manual step.
A migrated lesson with progress above 0 opens the same task in both apps with a Next button. Progress 0 opens task 1. Use the progress values of migrated-data-checks.sql (FR-5).

A quiz with a migrated completed = false row finishes in the new app. A double click gives XP one time. Legacy gives a second row and XP two times (E-4, difference on purpose). The finish is a manual step on the clone.
Task 8 of a finished SAQ shows the saved answer, the feedback, and the score in both apps. Pick an article with an SA_QUESTION row that has details.
The student changes the display name. The header shows it. The sign-in username does not change.
A code-only session gets an error message (manual step with a class-code session).
Every sentence of the article shows one time, in order, in 3 blocks. Compare the text files of both captures.
Second article: every sentence shows one time, in order, in 3 blocks.
After one completion, the home XP and the header gem rise by the xpEarned of the completion. Read users.xp before and after on the clone (SQL, FR-10). The game play is a manual step.
The chip shows the state of this student only, for a saved and for an unsaved article.
After the three quizzes, 3 to 5 new words and all sentences are in the decks (SQL on flashcard_decks and flashcard_cards).

The footer link "Support" opens /contact. The email link is mailto:support@reading-advantage.com. NOTE: needs primary/public-pages merge. The change is on branch primary/public-pages (c7228ab74), not on this build until the merge.

A new 6-character class code in the query opens the name step. The code comes from the environment variable PARITY_NEW_CLASS_CODE inside the steps module (no code in this file). Legacy takes only the old 8-character code, a difference on purpose.

An old 8-character migrated code in the query shows the note "This link has an old class code" in the new app. The code comes from PARITY_OLD_CLASS_CODE inside the steps module. Legacy signs in with this code.
